high_level_description: This is a black-and-white photograph of a person posing for a portrait. The individual has long, wavy hair that falls over their shoulders. They are wearing a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows and a dark vest over it. Their left hand is raised to their neck, with fingers gently touching the collar of their shirt. On their wrist, they wear two bracelets, one of which appears to be a watch or a similar accessory. The background is plain and neutral, likely a studio setting, which helps to focus attention on the subject.
